# code-block-style

- ID: `MD046`
- Category: Code
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: no
- Tags: `code`

Code blocks all use the first block's style, fenced or indented.

## Why

One code block style makes the source easier to read.

## Options

Set them under `rules.code-block-style.options`.

- `style` (`string`, default `consistent`): Code block style to require.
  consistent takes the style of the first block. Values: `consistent`, `fenced`,
  `indented`.

## Fix

There is no automatic fix.

## Configure

```yaml
rules:
  code-block-style:
    options:
      style: consistent
```

Under `rules`, `code-block-style: false` turns the rule off and
`code-block-style: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable code-block-style` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line code-block-style -->
```
